ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p MOVEit/GoAnywhere/Accellion zero-day webshell drop (LEMURLOOT/DEWMODE) via IIS w3wp.exe
ucs.description: Hunts Cl0p's signature managed-file-transfer (MFT) exploitation chain — SQL-injection against MOVEit Transfer, GoAnywhere MFT, or Accellion FTA — landing an ASPX/JSP webshell (LEMURLOOT a.k.a. human2.aspx, DEWMODE, or LEMURLOOT-style) written by the web service identity. This is the exact tradecraft that drove Cl0p's 2021 (Accellion), 2023-Feb (GoAnywhere CVE-2023-0669) and 2023-May (MOVEit CVE-2023-34362) mass-exploitation waves.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created (Filesystem.file_name IN ("human2.aspx","_human2.aspx","App_Web_*.dll","error_page.jsp","OkHttpClient.aspx") OR Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*","*\\GoAnywhere\\userdata\\webcontent\\*","*/var/opt/cdrive/*")) (Filesystem.process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","tomcat*.exe","httpd","nginx") OR Filesystem.user IN ("NT AUTHORITY\\NETWORK SERVICE","IIS APPPOOL*","tomcat","goanywhere")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | rename dest as host | join type=outer host [| tstats summariesonly=t count as child_proc_count values(Processes.process) as child_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as child_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","tomcat*.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","sqlcmd.exe","bcp.exe","7z.exe","certutil.exe") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename dest as host] | where isnotnull(file_name) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let MFTPaths = dynamic([@"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\", @"\GoAnywhere\userdata\webcontent\", "/var/opt/cdrive/", @"\inetpub\wwwroot\"]);
let WebshellNames = dynamic(["human2.aspx","_human2.aspx","error_page.jsp","OkHttpClient.aspx","LemurLoot.aspx"]);
let WebshellWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe")
    | where (FileName in~ (WebshellNames))
         or (FolderPath has_any (MFTPaths) and FileName endswith ".aspx")
         or (FolderPath has_any (MFTPaths) and FileName endswith ".jsp")
         or (FolderPath has_any (MFTPaths) and FileName matches regex @"App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8,}\.dll")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let HandsOnKeyboard = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","sqlcmd.exe","bcp.exe","7z.exe","certutil.exe","nltest.exe")
    | project ChildTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, ChildImage = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebshellWrites
| join kind=leftouter HandsOnKeyboard on DeviceName
| where isnull(ChildTime) or (ChildTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 24h))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildTime, ChildImage, ChildCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WebshellNames = dynamic(["human2.aspx","_human2.aspx","error_page.jsp","OkHttpClient.aspx","LemurLoot.aspx"]);
let MFTPaths = dynamic([@"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\", @"\GoAnywhere\userdata\webcontent\", "/var/opt/cdrive/"]);
let FileDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType =~ "FileCreated"
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe")
    | where TargetFileName in~ (WebshellNames)
         or (TargetFilePath has_any (MFTPaths) and (TargetFileExtension =~ "aspx" or TargetFileExtension =~ "jsp"))
         or (TargetFilePath has_any (MFTPaths) and TargetFileName matches regex @"App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8,}\.dll")
    | project FileTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256, ActingProcessName, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine;
let WebProcs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe")
    | where TargetProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","sqlcmd.exe","bcp.exe","7z.exe","certutil.exe","nltest.exe")
    | project ChildTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName;
FileDrops
| join kind=leftouter WebProcs on DvcHostname
| where isnull(ChildTime) or (ChildTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + 24h))
| project TimeGenerated = FileTime, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256,
          ActingProcessName, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildTime, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Cl0p LEMURLOOT / DEWMODE Webshell Drop by MFT Web Service
id: 8a4f1c7e-2a3e-4b5d-9c1f-1f0c11a0c0e1
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx / App_Web_*.dll), DEWMODE, or GoAnywhere webshells by the IIS/Tomcat/Java service account in MOVEit, GoAnywhere or Accellion MFT directories — Cl0p / FIN11 / TA505 tradecraft from CVE-2023-34362, CVE-2023-0669 and the 2021 Accellion FTA campaign.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_process:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat10.exe'
  selection_webshell_name:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\human2.aspx'
      - '\_human2.aspx'
      - '\error_page.jsp'
      - '\OkHttpClient.aspx'
      - '\LemurLoot.aspx'
  selection_mft_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\'
      - '\GoAnywhere\userdata\webcontent\'
      - '\Accellion\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.jsp'
      - '.ashx'
  selection_lemurloot_dll:
    TargetFilename|re: 'App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8,}\.dll'
  condition: selection_process and (selection_webshell_name or selection_mft_path or selection_lemurloot_dll)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate MOVEit / GoAnywhere installer or patch run (Progress / Fortra MSP)
  - Internal webapp deploy pipelines writing into wwwroot
level: critical

ucs.falcon_logscale_query: #event_simpleName=FileWritten (ContextImageFileName=/\\(w3wp|java|tomcat9|tomcat10)\.exe$/i OR ContextImageFileName=/\/(java|httpd|nginx|tomcat)/i) | (TargetFileName=/\\(human2|_human2|OkHttpClient|LemurLoot)\.aspx$/i OR TargetFileName=/\\error_page\.jsp$/i OR (regex("(MOVEitTransfer\\\\wwwroot|GoAnywhere\\\\userdata\\\\webcontent|Accellion|/var/opt/cdrive/)", field=TargetFileName) AND TargetFileName=/\.(aspx|jsp|ashx)$/i) OR TargetFileName=/App_Web_[a-z0-9]{8,}\.dll$/i) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)]) | sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p MFT exfiltration — sqlcmd/bcp dump to archive followed by HTTPS upload to anonymous file host
ucs.description: Hunts the post-exploitation 'data theft' half of Cl0p's MFT campaigns: the webshell (LEMURLOOT/DEWMODE) reads MFT metadata from the backing SQL DB, the operator dumps it via sqlcmd/bcp, 7-Zips it, and exfils to anonymous file hosts (mega.nz, anonfiles, dropmefiles, transfer[.]sh) or to Cl0p's own clearnet leak/exfil hosts. This is the distinctive 'steal-not-encrypt' phase Cl0p pivoted to in 2021+.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("sqlcmd.exe","bcp.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe") (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","java.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*MOVEit*","*GoAnywhere*","*moveitsvc*","*-Q*select*","*queryout*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename dest as host | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=t count as egress_count values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest_host values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip sum(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest IN ("*mega.nz","*mega.co.nz","*anonfiles.com","*transfer.sh","*dropmefiles.com","*temp.sh","*gofile.io","*sendspace.com","*file.io","*ufile.io","*clop-leaks.com") OR All_Traffic.dest_port=443 by All_Traffic.src | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | rename src as host | where bytes_out > 10485760] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ExfilHosts = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","anonfiles.com","transfer.sh","dropmefiles.com","temp.sh","gofile.io","sendspace.com","file.io","ufile.io","bayfiles.com"]);
let DbDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("sqlcmd.exe","bcp.exe")
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEit","moveitsvc","GoAnywhere","files","queryout","-Q select","-Q \"select"))
         or (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
             and InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","services.exe"))
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Archive = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" a "," -p",".7z",".rar",".zip")
    | project ArcTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, ArcCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ArcAccount = AccountName;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (ExfilHosts) or RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","w3wp.exe","java.exe")
         or RemoteUrl has_any (ExfilHosts)
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DbDump
| join kind=inner Archive on DeviceName
| where ArcTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 6h)
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceName
| where EgressTime between (ArcTime .. ArcTime + 12h)
| project DumpTime, ArcTime, EgressTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DumpCmd, ArcCmd, EgressProc, EgressCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

let ExfilHosts = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","anonfiles.com","transfer.sh","dropmefiles.com","temp.sh","gofile.io","sendspace.com","file.io","ufile.io","bayfiles.com"]);
let DbDump = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetProcessName has_any ("sqlcmd.exe","bcp.exe")
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEit","GoAnywhere","moveitsvc","queryout","-Q select","-Q \"select")
         or ParentProcessName has_any ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, DumpCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let Archive = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetProcessName has_any ("7z.exe","7za.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (" a "," -p",".7z",".rar",".zip")
    | project ArcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ArcCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DstHostname has_any (ExfilHosts) or Url has_any (ExfilHosts)
    | project EgressTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DstHostname, DstIpAddr, Url, NetworkBytes;
DbDump
| join kind=inner Archive on DvcHostname
| where ArcTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 6h)
| join kind=inner Egress on DvcHostname
| where EgressTime between (ArcTime .. ArcTime + 12h)
| project TimeGenerated = DumpTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, DumpCmd, ArcCmd, DstHostname, DstIpAddr, Url, NetworkBytes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) AND ((@EventID:(1 OR 4688) AND @Image:(*\sqlcmd.exe OR *\SQLCMD.EXE OR *\bcp.exe OR *\BCP.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*MOVEit* OR *GoAnywhere* OR *moveitsvc* OR *queryout* OR *"-Q select"* OR *"-Q \"select"*)) OR (@EventID:(1 OR 4688) AND @ParentImage:(*\w3wp.exe OR *\java.exe OR *\tomcat9.exe) AND @Image:(*\7z.exe OR *\7Z.EXE OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\rar.exe)) OR (@EventID:3 AND @Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\megacmd.exe OR *\MEGAclient.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\powershell.exe) AND @DestinationHostname:(*.mega.nz OR *.anonfiles.com OR *.transfer.sh OR *.gofile.io OR *.dropmefiles.com OR *.file.io OR *.ufile.io OR *.sendspace.com))))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query: (#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 OR #event_simpleName=DnsRequest OR #event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4) | case { #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(sqlcmd|bcp)\.exe$/i regex("(MOVEit|GoAnywhere|moveitsvc|queryout|-Q\\s+[\"']?select)", field=CommandLine, flags="i") | stage:="dump"; #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|WinRAR|Rar)\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/(w3wp|java|cmd|powershell)\.exe$/i regex("\\s+a\\s+|\\.(7z|rar|zip)", field=CommandLine, flags="i") | stage:="archive"; #event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mega\.(nz|co\.nz)|anonfiles\.com|transfer\.sh|gofile\.io|dropmefiles\.com|file\.io|ufile\.io|sendspace\.com|bayfiles\.com)$/i | stage:="egress"; * | stage:="other" } | stage!="other" | groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[collect([stage]), count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)]) | array:contains("stage", value="dump") AND array:contains("stage", value="egress") | sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Cl0p / TA505 / FIN11 pivoted away from pure ransomware to data-theft-and-extortion in 2021 and after the Babuk source leak, leans heavily on this exact sequence: webshell -> sqlcmd/bcp dumping the MOVEit / GoAnywhere SQL backend -> 7-Zip/WinRAR archive -> egress over HTTPS to anonymous file hosts (Mandiant and CISA AA23-158A explicitly cite MEGA, anonfiles and Cl0p clearnet hosts).
